caption_used: Negative log-probabilities for clinically relevant tokens between baseline MistralV0.2-Base and the same model further fine-tuned on each specialty data. The chart displays six specialty groups along the x-axis (Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, Pediatrics), with the y-axis showing negative log probability ranging from approximately -27 to -22. Within each group, the MistralV0.2-Base bar (light blue) consistently shows the highest negative log probability, indicating weaker token predictions at baseline. Among the fine-tuned models, the Gastro-tuned variant achieves the lowest negative log probability across most specialty groups, suggesting strong cross-specialty transfer. Notably, the Infect group shows the largest overall bar heights, with baseline reaching approximately -23.5, while the Cardio group exhibits the smallest spread between baseline and fine-tuned variants at roughly 1.5 units.
raw_response: DESCRIPTION: This grouped bar chart illustrates the negative log-probabilities for clinically relevant tokens, comparing a baseline model (MistralV0.2-Base) with versions of the same model fine-tuned on six different medical specialty datasets. The horizontal axis is labeled "Per-specialty terms" and contains six categorical groups: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The vertical axis is labeled "Negative log probability" and uses a linear scale ranging from approximately -27 to -22, with tick marks at integer intervals. Within each group, seven bars are displayed: one light blue bar representing MistralV0.2-Base, and six bars representing models fine-tuned on each specialty — Cardio (light yellow), Gastro (light tan/peach), Infect (medium orange), Neuro (darker orange), Obstetrics (dark brown-orange), and Pediatrics (dark brown). Across all six specialty groups, the light blue MistralV0.2-Base bar consistently reaches approximately -22, representing the highest (least negative) value. For the Cardio group, the fine-tuned model bars range from approximately -26.2 (Gastro-tuned) to around -22.5, with most bars falling between -25.5 and -26. In the Gastro group, the fine-tuned bars extend to approximately -24 to -24.5, with the baseline again near -22. The Infect group shows the baseline bar at roughly -22.2, with fine-tuned bars reaching approximately -22.5 to -23.5, exhibiting a relatively smaller spread. The Neuro group displays fine-tuned bars ranging from about -24.5 to -25, while the Obstetrics group shows fine-tuned bars spanning approximately -23.5 to -24.5. The Pediatrics group has fine-tuned bars reaching roughly -23.5 to -24.5. The bars are not sorted by value within each group but follow a consistent left-to-right ordering matching the legend sequence. No bars appear to be specially emphasized through outlining or annotation, though the light blue baseline bars are visually distinct due to their lighter color and consistently shorter downward extent compared to the fine-tuned variants.
